compliance_rule_results.rule_interpretation: Rehabilitation works for a calamity are to be completed within 18 months of approval.
A stopped or abandoned work requires full justification and referral to the State Nodal Authority.
Movable assets are for Government-owned or Government-controlled institutions and require the prescribed committee approval.
compliance_rule_results.threshold: Eligible Government user and committee approval

compliance_rule_results.rule_interpretation: MPLADS funds cannot be used for operation and maintenance of any nature.
Construction of residential buildings is not permissible.
Work involving commercial and private establishments is not permissible.

compliance_rule_results.rule_name: Naming an asset after a person
compliance_rule_results.rule_interpretation: An asset created under MPLADS cannot be named after any person.
Grants and loans are not permissible, subject to separate Chapter 6 assistance provisions.
Contribution to a Centre or State/UT Relief Fund is not permissible.
Acquisition of land or compensation for acquired land is not permissible.

compliance_rule_results.rule_name: Reimbursement of completed or incomplete work
compliance_rule_results.rule_interpretation: Reimbursement for completed or partly completed works or movable items is not permissible.

compliance_rule_results.guideline_basis: MPLADS Guidelines (April 1, 2023, including amendments), Paras 5.2.9 and 5.1.6
compliance_rule_results.rule_interpretation: Individual or family benefits are not permissible except for the specified assistive-device exception.
MPLADS funds cannot be pooled with Corporate Social Responsibility funds.
Religious works, religious worship premises, and land owned by a religious faith/group are not permissible.
Construction of Swagat Dwars or Welcome Gates is not permissible.
Works in an unauthorized colony are not permissible.
Recurring expenditure of any kind is not permissible.
